tools.name: list_issues
tools.description: List the issues of a team, with their id, title, status, labels, relations and last update.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Get one issue by id, with its description, status, labels, relations and last update.

tools.name: save_issue
tools.description: Create an issue, or update the issue named by id. On an update, only the fields given change. blockedBy replaces the issues blocking this one.

id.description: The issue to update; omit to create one

blockedBy.description: Ids of the issues blocking this one
